## Policy, manuals, and past cases

### [doc:payment-holds#how-to-confirm-a-real-duplicate] Payment Holds and Duplicate-Looking Charges / How to confirm a real duplicate
A real duplicate charge shows two captured (settled) transactions for the same order. A pending authorization plus one settled capture is not a duplicate and must not be refunded. Real duplicates are refunded in full and flagged to the Payments team.
Key line: "A pending authorization plus one settled capture is not a duplicate and must not be refunded."

### [doc:payment-holds#when-the-hold-disappears] Payment Holds and Duplicate-Looking Charges / When the hold disappears
The authorization hold is released automatically by SliceBot at delivery. Most banks remove the pending hold within 3 to 5 business days. The customer is only ever billed once.
Key line: "The authorization hold is released automatically by SliceBot at delivery."

### [doc:payment-holds#why-customers-see-two-charges] Payment Holds and Duplicate-Looking Charges / Why customers see two charges
When an order is placed, SliceBot places a temporary authorization hold for the order total. When the order is delivered, the final amount is captured as a separate transaction. For a short time the customer's bank may show both the hold and the final charge, which looks like a double charge.
Key line: "When an order is placed, SliceBot places a temporary authorization hold for the order total."

### [doc:escalation-guidelines#what-a-good-handoff-contains] Escalation Guidelines / What a good handoff contains
A handoff must include the customer's request in one sentence, what was checked, what the agent recommends, and the policy that applies. The specialist should not need to ask the customer to repeat anything.

### [doc:identity-verification#what-unverified-contacts-can-get] Identity Verification / What unverified contacts can get
Unverified contacts may receive general information, such as policies, delivery areas, and product guidance. They must not be told account details, order contents, addresses, or payment information, and no credits, refunds, or account changes may be made.

### [doc:TR-0006#conversation] Chat transcript TR-0006 / Conversation (past case: supporting history, not policy)
Customer: I think I was charged twice.
Specialist: I checked your payments. One is a temporary authorization hold and one is the final charge. The hold was released at delivery and should disappear from your bank in 3 to 5 business days.
Customer: Thanks.

Outcome: Explained authorization hold. No refund.
Key line: "One is a temporary authorization hold and one is the final charge."

## Limits that apply

- At most $20.00 back per order without a specialist; never split a refund to fit.
